summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a 6-K reporting results of a tender offer for its own shares, completed on April 27, 2026. The issuer resolved on March 30, 2026 to repurchase shares at ¥3,067 per share, a 20-business-day offer period ending April 27, 2026. The board approved via written resolution; no advisor named. The settlement date is May 25, 2026, with treasury shares retired on June 30, 2026. This is a standard issuer tender (buyback) under Japanese law, mapped to a US issuer tender offer. Watch for completion of retirement and impact on share count.
